work.author: ACTA GREGORII PP. XVI.
work.description: Consistorial allocution CXLII publishing seven cardinals reserved in pectore and creating Velzi and Mattei; speech from Venerabiles fratres 22915 through the creation formula and Amen 23077, before numeral CXLIII (garbled CAEL) 23080. LF22970 and LF23059 are page numbers 147 and 148. The editorial caption 22892–22893 reads diei rr iunii 1892; the day and year glyphs are not normalized, so the act date is left unknown. Issuer evidence ACTA GREGORII PP. XVI. at LF23130 (running-title context; see source_attribution_context). Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
